verdict.rationale: dLocal documents accepting local currencies and settling funds globally, which covers the core of charging locally and settling. Nothing in the evidence shows settlement into the merchant's own currency or how FX conversion is handled and disclosed. missing for 10: explicit settlement-currency conversion to the merchant's home currency, transparent FX rate/fee disclosure, detailed first-party FX docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling

citations.quote: Accept and disburse the local payment methods and currencies billions of consumers prefer — all through one platform.
